result.reason: The redline appropriately extends use to contractors acting on Sparkling’s behalf and permits transfer in an M&A transaction, but it omits the required perpetual and irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences and the uncured-material-breach termination limitation for subscription licences. It also unnecessarily gives Garman a reciprocal no-consent assignment right, changing supplier-side commercial rights beyond what the playbook requires. Further, the licence remains described as “non-transferable” without an express qualification in the grant itself, creating avoidable tension with Section 20(d).
